student_inference: ResNet18 embedding followed by cosine similarity
writer_batch_structure: Each writer contributes pages p1, p2, p3, p4
teacher_arabic_prototype: L2-normalized mean of teacher embeddings for p1 and p2
teacher_english_prototype: L2-normalized mean of teacher embeddings for p3 and p4
student_arabic_prototype: L2-normalized mean of student embeddings for p1 and p2
student_english_prototype: L2-normalized mean of student embeddings for p3 and p4
distillation_loss: Weighted off-diagonal MSE from both student relation matrices to the shared teacher consensus
base_writer_supervision: Same matched Arabic metric and cross-script metric supervision used in Notebook 23
primary_comparator: existing WGC compact model on the identical 145-fit / 36-selection protocol

interpretation.condition_guardrail: No cross-script condition should lose more than 0.005 AUC
